description: Memvara: recall on every prompt, capture when a turn ends. Every command goes through run.py, which binds the host record in hosts/claude.py before dispatching -- the client's field names, reply keys and event names are data there rather than literals in the hook bodies. Capture runs async so a 12-14s extraction never holds the turn open; async hook output is discarded by the client, so its record is ~/.memvara/.hooks/capture.log rather than a systemMessage.
